description:
Enable the 'Billable Time' module in Manager.io and create two billable time entries.

First, navigate to Settings (or Customize) to enable the 'Billable Time' tab so it appears in the sidebar.

Then, create the following entries in the new module:
1. Customer: Alfreds Futterkiste
   - Date: 2024-12-15
   - Description: Annual tax return preparation and filing
   - Hours: 6.5
   - Hourly Rate: 150.00

2. Customer: Ernst Handel
   - Date: 2024-12-18
   - Description: Quarterly VAT return review and advisory
   - Hours: 3.25
   - Hourly Rate: 175.00

Ensure both entries are saved and visible in the Billable Time list.

entry1.description: Annual tax return preparation and filing

entry2.description: Quarterly VAT return review and advisory
